),
parent_tasks AS ( SELECT task_id, task_name, task_des, task_status, is_test, is_design, task_depth, pt_task_id, task_st, task_et, task_rst, task_ret, task_asi, task_rate, pjt_id, user_id FROM search_matches

SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.is_design, t.task_depth, t.pt_task_id, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, t.user_id FROM project_task t INNER JOIN parent_tasks pt ON t.task_id = pt.pt_task_id WHERE t.pjt_id = #{pjtId} ),
child_tasks AS ( SELECT task_id, task_name, task_des, task_status, is_test, is_design, task_depth, pt_task_id, task_st, task_et, task_rst, task_ret, task_asi, task_rate, pjt_id, user_id FROM search_matches
UNION ALL
SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.is_design, t.task_depth, t.pt_task_id, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, t.user_id FROM project_task t INNER JOIN child_tasks ct ON t.pt_task_id = ct.task_id WHERE t.pjt_id = #{pjtId} ),
all_related_tasks AS ( SELECT DISTINCT * FROM parent_tasks UNION SELECT DISTINCT * FROM child_tasks ),
task_hierarchy AS ( SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.is_design, t.task_depth, t.pt_task_id, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, t.user_id, pt.task_name as pt_task_name, CAST(t.task_id AS CHAR(1000)) AS sort_path FROM all_related_tasks t LEFT JOIN project_task pt ON t.pt_task_id = pt.task_id WHERE t.pt_task_id IS NULL OR t.pt_task_id = '' OR t.pt_task_id NOT IN (SELECT task_id FROM all_related_tasks)
UNION ALL
SELECT t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_des, t.task_status, t.is_test, t.is_design, t.task_depth, t.pt_task_id, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi, t.task_rate, t.pjt_id, t.user_id, pt.task_name as pt_task_name, CONCAT(th.sort_path, '-', t.task_id) AS sort_path FROM all_related_tasks t INNER JOIN task_hierarchy th ON t.pt_task_id = th.task_id LEFT JOIN project_task pt ON t.pt_task_id = pt.task_id ), ranked_tasks AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sort_path) as rn FROM task_hierarchy ) SELECT task_id as taskId, task_name as taskName, task_des as taskDes, task_status as taskStatus, is_test as isTest, is_design as isDesign, task_depth as taskDepth, pt_task_id as ptTaskId, pt_task_name as ptTaskName, task_st as taskSt, task_et as taskEt, task_rst as taskRst, task_ret as taskRet, task_asi as taskAsi, task_rate as taskRate, pjt_id as pjtId, user_id as userId FROM ranked_tasks WHERE rn BETWEEN ((#{pageIndex} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageIndex} * #{pageSize}) ORDER BY sort_path
